definitions.gloss: job hunting; seeking employment; job search
definitions.explanation: The act of looking for a job or employment. A formal term used in official and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {求職|きゅうしょく}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
⟦ハローワーク→ハローワーク：28059_haroowaaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{求職|きゅうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I registered as a job seeker at Hello Work (the employment office).

examples.japanese: ⟦{求職者|きゅうしょくしゃ}→求職者：21747_kyuushokusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}される→左右される：26073_sayuusareru⟧。
examples.english: The number of job seekers is greatly affected by economic fluctuations.

notes: Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form {求職|きゅうしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to seek employment). Common collocations: {求職|きゅうしょく}{者|しゃ} (job seeker), {求職|きゅうしょく}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (job-hunting activities), {求職|きゅうしょく}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (currently job hunting). Pairs with ⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧ (job offer/recruitment) — together they form the labor market: ⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦{倍率|ばいりつ}→倍率：15067_bairitsu⟧ (job-to-applicant ratio). Homophones: ⟦{休職|きゅうしょく}→休職：18305_kyuushoku⟧ (leave of absence from work), ⟦{給食|きゅうしょく}→給食：13800_kyuushoku⟧ (school lunch) — different kanji and meanings. Related: ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧ (getting a job — the result, not the search), ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧ (changing jobs).
